purpose: One fixed small discriminative residual instead of the E39 high-parameter neural student; no Android adoption by a host gate alone.
features: Character 1/2/3-grams ending in the candidate (including up to two left characters or BOS), counts divided by sqrt(candidate length), no EOS; retain only features present in at least two distinct train source families. Plus the same 17 actual decoder features scaled /32 and clipped to [-4,4].

training.source: E39 isolated 512-source-sentence weak train input and its 751 qualified teacher groups; regenerate all current-production candidate features and require exact text, score and feature equality before teacher reuse
training.residual: original total + 8*tanh(sparse linear output/8); zero weights exactly preserve original scores
training.loss: 0.75 gold CE + 0.25 T^2 KL(teacher PLL/T || student total/T), T=2; query groups equally weighted
training.optimizer: Deterministic float64 full-batch L-BFGS-B, zero initialization, maxiter 200, ftol 1e-10, gtol 1e-7, ridge 0.01
training.selection: One vocabulary threshold, regularizer and fit; final optimizer result only, no sweep or dev checkpoint selection
training.labels: Existing automatic pypinyin weak labels, not new human annotation

inference: E39 first-eight equal-length Han 2..24 slots and source protections; fall back whole row if a selected source is not BASE_EXACT/BASE_COMPOSED or feature validation fails. Features not seen in training contribute zero. Reference labels and teacher scores never enter scoring.
qualityGate: Each known dev domain top1/top5 nondecreasing and character errors nonincreasing; all candidate sets unchanged and combined top1 strictly increases. Preserve every gain/loss, not a blind-test claim.
costGate: Warm extra host P95 <= 100 ms, separately report model size; not an Android timing claim
stopRule: If the fixed dev trial fails, preserve evidence and do not open old test/Android evaluation to seek a pass; keep rc.5 unchanged. If it passes, independent old regression and Android/lifecycle gates still required.
